This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|tan]] skin mottled with dark spots and stripes, as well as massive, pointed ears featuring long hairs protruding from within.<ref name="COC" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' places the [[Battle of Exegol]] one year after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[34 ABY]], therefore putting the battle in [[35 ABY]].</ref> a member of this species participated in the [[Battle of Exegol]] as part of [[Citizens' Fleet|the fleet]] the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' gathered from the [[Core Worlds]], traveling to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] to join their victory celebrations afterwards.<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[2019]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" />
